definitions.explanation: The front part of the throat, from the base of the chin to the upper chest. Used both literally and in many figurative expressions.

examples.japanese: {喉元|のどもと}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{出|で}かかって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It's on the tip of my tongue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{喉元|のどもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: Something hot passed through my throat.

examples.japanese: {喉元|のどもと}⟦{過|す}ぎれば→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{苦|くる}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: They say you forget the pain once it passes, but I can never forget that suffering.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧ (throat) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (area around). Refers to the front of the throat, a vulnerable and sensitive area. Appears in several well-known proverbs and idiomatic expressions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {喉元|のどもと}⟦{過|す}ぎれば→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: once the heat passes the throat, you forget the pain — people quickly forget hardship once it's over
- {喉元|のどもと}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{出|で}かかる: to be on the tip of one's tongue — almost able to recall something
- {喉元|のどもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突|つ}きつける→突きつける：10542_tsukitsukeru⟧: to hold (a blade) to someone's throat — to press someone hard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧: throat — the general body part; {喉元|のどもと} emphasizes the front surface area
- ⟦{胸元|むなもと}→胸元：22092_munamoto⟧: chest area — slightly lower, around the upper chest and neckline
- ⟦{首元|くびもと}→首元：24294_kubimoto⟧: neck area — the area around the neck, including the sides and back
